venue: Narayana Engineering College, Nellore, Andhra Pradesh, India
title: SAC IEEE Hyderabad Section, in association with Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS),GNI , IEEE SB NECN, and IEEE SB VNRVJIET, 2day workshop on Skilling
description:
Greetings!

2-Day Workshop & Off Campus Job Drive on System Engineer (Wireless & Embedded)

GyanNidhi Innovations (GNI), in association with Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS), SAC IEEE Hyderabad Section, IEEE SB Narayana Engineering College, Nellore (NECN), and IEEE SB VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology, invites you to join us.

We are delighted to welcome you to the Skilling Hybrid Workshop and Job Fair.

Congratulations to the 30 students from various engineering colleges who have successfully secured placements through our previous workshops and GNI courses.

Best wishes to our prospective students who are currently completing their online courses.

Certification will be awarded only to students who attend the session and complete the relevant GNI course.

Completion of the Wireless FAE course is mandatory to attend the workshop.

Date: 30th & 31st March 2026
Timings: 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Mode: Physical and Online
Physical Venue: Narayana Engineering College, Nellore (NECN) & Others Online

Day 1 – 30th March 2026
• Embedded System Architecture Case Study
• Wireless and Defence System
• Data Conversion Products – FPGA, Microcontroller, CPU and GPU
• Link Budget Analysis and EM Wave Fundamentals
• Key Instruments for RF and Wireless Testing
• Signal Generators and Spectrum Analyzers
• Industry Standard Serial and Parallel Protocols – I2C, SPI, Ethernet and UART

Day 2 – 31st March 2026
• Embedded System Programming and Debugging
• Practical Tools for Signal Debugging and Analysis – Hercules, Wireshark and Tera Terminal
• RF Testing Fundamentals
• Test Reports Preparation and Understanding – LNA Test Reports and Amplifiers Test Reports
• Drone Technology & Robotics
• Electronic Products Manufacturing Technology

Expected Outcomes
• Exposure to industrial-grade wireless telecom and embedded systems
• Practical assignments
• 15–20 internship/job opportunities

Speakers
• Dr. Ravi Kishore – Founder, Huviiro Corp
• Dr. M. Lakshminarayana – Retired Associate Director, DRDL & Head R&D, UTS
• Mr. K. Srinivasa Raju – CEO, UTS
• Mr. M. Ravi – Learning and Development Manager, UTS
• Mr. Dhanabal Ramu – Founder, Sri Vaari Automations
